_source.what: Per-query parameters for bi-01..bi-18 at graph-benchmark-ldbc SF0.1. Every value is ONE Cypher expression string; the lane evaluates it once (RETURN <expr>) and binds the result as the statement's parameter — the engine's native parameter binding (ADR-0479), never textual substitution.
_source.why: Upstream's own :params defaults (chosen on SNB BI SF1 data by the benchmark authors) are starting points over the graph-benchmark-ldbc store, whose ids and tag populations differ; a param whose query answers empty at SF0.1 is substituted with a same-kind value that has rows (ADR-0247 precedent) and the substitution is recorded in the workload README's classification table.
_source.regenerate: params are store-specific: regenerate per store/scale factor by checking each query's row count and substituting empty-answer params same-kind (seed-policy.md section 4); record substitutions in the README. The published ldbc-snb-bi parameter archives are NOT used — their entity ids exist in no graph-benchmark-ldbc store.

mapping.creationDate: ISO string in graph-benchmark-ldbc — every comparison wrapped in datetime()
mapping.id: ID (graph-benchmark-ldbc names the id column ID)

_source.skipped: bi-10 (APOC), bi-15/19/20 (GDS) — out of dialect permanently, never translated
